commit.message:
🐛(codemod) Report unsupported migration patterns (#7642)

## Description

> AI-agent disclosure: this PR was authored by an automated
> agent (Codex / GPT-6) and has not been
> line-by-line reviewed by a human before submission.

Unsupported migration patterns currently stay unchanged without telling
users what still needs attention. Emit `api.report()` warnings with the
source location and a reason when the existing codemods cannot safely
migrate a matched pattern.

- Report unsupported `check()` contexts, default imports with
attributes, Random calls, dynamic generator names, and Unicode flags.
- Recognize optional Random calls before skipping them, while keeping
bounded `nextInt()` calls and known generator factories quiet.
- Extend the existing fixture spec to require a report for every
`unsupported-` fixture and no reports for the other fixtures. Add
regression fixtures for the affected branches.
- Document the warnings and include a patch changeset for
`@fast-check/codemod`.

Warnings leave unsupported code unchanged and do not fail the CLI.

## Validation

- `pnpm test --run --project @fast-check/codemod` — 153 tests passed.
- Confirmed the unsupported-report assertions fail against the original
transforms.
- Codemod typecheck, build, and bundle tests passed.
- Formatting and lint checks passed; lint retains the two existing
empty-file warnings in `test-bundle/empty.ts` and `test-types/empty.ts`.
- Verified the built CLI prints the warning and location in a dry run.
